about: What the live feed watches (bullet, dated). Indices and every F&O stock with its nearest-expiry options around the money, inside Upstox's per-connection limits (standard plan, Nov 2026: one connection may hold ltpc 2000 + option_greeks 2000 + full 1500 keys when modes are mixed). If the plan does not fit, stock options are dropped first (most expensive stocks first) and the drop is logged. Changing this needs a CHANGELOG line.
